title: Tawheed card sort (12 statements)
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: Important Lessons for Every Muslim (units 1, 4 and 5)
source: Written for islamic-studies/y7 lesson 33 (Pupil PDF worksheet: tawheed card sort (12 statements))
intro: Lesson 33: Important Lessons unit 4: the three categories of tawheed. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

cards: Only Allah gives rain and life.
Allah alone created the heavens and the earth.
Allah controls the sun and the moon.
Sacrificing an animal for Allah only.
Allah is Ar-Rahman, the Most Merciful.
We affirm Allah's names as He described them, without asking 'how'.
blocks.title: Sort into: Rububiyyah / Uluhiyyah / Asma' was-sifat
blocks.task: sort them into the three categories.
blocks.answer: Only Allah gives rain and life. Rububiyyah; Allah alone created the heavens and the earth. Rububiyyah; Allah controls the sun and the moon. Rububiyyah; Only Allah gives provision (rizq). Rububiyyah; Making du'a to Allah alone. Uluhiyyah; Praying salah for Allah only. Uluhiyyah; Sacrificing an animal for Allah only. Uluhiyyah; Trusting in Allah alone (tawakkul). Uluhiyyah; Allah is As-Sami', the All-Hearing. Asma' was-sifat; Allah is Ar-Rahman, the Most Merciful. Asma' was-sifat; Nothing is like Allah. Asma' was-sifat; We affirm Allah's names as He described them, without asking 'how'. Asma' was-sifat

head: Category
Means
Example
rows: Only Allah gives rain and life
Du'a, salah, sacrifice for Allah only

passage.title: az-Zukhruf 43:87
paras: If you asked them who created them, they would surely say: Allah.

panels.title: Names without likening
points: Affirm what Allah says about Himself

keywords.def: Allah alone creates, owns and controls
Allah's names and attributes, without likening them to creation

questions.q: Explain why believing Allah is the Creator is not enough on its own.
questions.a: The Quraysh believed Allah created (43:87) but worshipped others; tawheed al-uluhiyyah, worshipping Allah alone, is what the messengers called to.

questions.q: 'Allah alone gives life and death' is tawheed ...

Card sort then paragraph: sort twelve statements on the pupil PDF into the three categories; then in the portal response box explain how all three appear in al-Fatihah. Start: 'In al-Fatihah, rububiyyah appears in ...'
questions.a: Rububiyyah: Rabbil-'alamin (1:2); asma' was-sifat: Ar-Rahman Ar-Raheem (1:3); uluhiyyah: You alone we worship (1:5)

questions.q: Extend: give a name of Allah and what it means for how I act.
questions.a: As-Sami': He hears me, so I guard my tongue

questions.q: Making du'a to Allah alone is tawheed ...
questions.a: A) al-uluhiyyah. Du'a is worship, so it belongs to uluhiyyah.

questions.q: Think again: is believing in a Creator enough?
questions.a: No: worship must also be for Allah alone
